title: Media library
intro: All your images and videos. Upload new ones, describe them (for people with low vision, and Google) and see where each one is used.
alreadyInLibrary: Already in the media library · “{name}”: moved to the top of “Recently added”
addToEnd: Add {name} to the end of the project
itemCount: {count, plural, one {# media item} other {# media items}}
noMatch: No media item matches this filter.
libraryEmpty: Your library is empty: upload files above.
stripHelp: Drag a thumbnail into the strip, between two slots or onto an empty slot; “+” adds it at the end.
usedTimes: {count, plural, =0 {Not used} one {Used once} other {Used # times}}
playsInLoop: played in a loop in projects
altLabel: Image description (for people with low vision, and Google)
altHelp: Describe what you see, in one sentence. People who cannot see the image hear it, and Google understands it better.
tagsSavedHelp: Saved right away. Press Enter to confirm a tag.
noAltNotice: Without a description, the image title is read instead.
usageLogo: Site logo, set from the page
inUseNote: {count, plural, one {Used in # place: replace it or remove it from that place before deleting it.} other {Used in # places: replace it or remove it from those places before deleting it.}}
deleteBody: It is not used anywhere. It stays in the media library trash for {days} days: you can restore it, or undo right after.
trashedNote: In the trash: permanently erased in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Once restored, it returns to its place in the media library.
purgeLost: the file and all its variants are erased.
bulkAdded: {tags, plural, one {# tag added} other {# tags added}} · {media, plural, one {# media item} other {# media items}}
bulkRemoved: {tags, plural, one {# tag removed} other {# tags removed}} · {media, plural, one {# media item} other {# media items}}
addToMedia: {count, plural, one {Add to # media item} other {Add to # media items}}
removeFromMedia: {count, plural, one {Remove from # media item} other {Remove from # media items}}
noTags: No tags yet: add some when uploading or in a media item's details.
unusedHelp: They are not on any media item and do not count towards the limit of 500.
purgeTitle: {count, plural, one {Delete # unused tag?} other {Delete # unused tags?}}
purgedUnused: {count, plural, one {# unused tag deleted} other {# unused tags deleted}}
deleteTagBody: {count, plural, one {It will be removed from # media item. The media items themselves are not affected.} other {It will be removed from # media items. The media items themselves are not affected.}}
tagOnNoMedia: It is not on any media item.
trashIntro: A deleted media item stays here for {days} days and can be restored in one click, then it is permanently erased with its files. Uploading the same file again also brings it back.
dropOne: Drop a file here, or choose it
pickerHelp: Click an image to choose it. The small magnifier enlarges it without choosing it.
